overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Paper focuses on unsupervised multi-document summarization using a spectral method. Human evaluation was conducted via Amazon Mechanical Turk with clear rating criteria. All automatic evaluation used ROUGE metrics. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was performed. The paper compares multiple summarization methods across three different datasets.
